title: QUIZ - 36
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Translate a verbal mathematical phrase into an algebraic expression
questions.question: Translate the following statement into an algebraic expression using the variable t: "twice a number, plus 13"
questions.explanation: "twice a number, plus 13" translates directly to \( 2t + 13 \), using t to represent the unknown number.
questions.hint: Identify the operation words (more than, less than, times, divided by) and translate them in order.

questions.learningObjective: Translate a real-world scenario with a fixed fee and a rate into an algebraic expression
questions.question: A phone plan costs $18 per month plus $3 per gigabyte used. Write an expression for the monthly cost if m gigabytes are used.
questions.explanation: The fixed amount ($18) is added once, and the rate ($3) is multiplied by m, giving \( 3m + 18 \).
questions.hint: Multiply the rate by the variable, then add the fixed amount.

questions.learningObjective: Translate a multi-step verbal statement involving grouping into an algebraic expression
questions.question: Translate into an algebraic expression using x: "Three times the sum of a number and 2, decreased by 2"
questions.explanation: "The sum of a number and 2" is (x + 2). "Three times" that sum is 3(x + 2). "Decreased by 2" gives \( 3(x + 2) - 2 \).
questions.hint: Translate from the innermost grouping outward: form the sum first, then apply the multiplier, then the final operation.
